label: school_main_chara_mathteacher_01

text: Oh, chi si vede, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].\nAnche oggi ti trovo in forma![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

label: school_main_chara_historyteacher_01
text: Ma perché sprechi il tuo tempo a parlare\ncon me? Che assurdità...[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: school_main_chara_historyteacher_02
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sei un[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0D0A)]o studentea studentessa decisamente interessante,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

label: school_main_chara_historyteacher_03

label: school_main_chara_historyteacher_04

label: school_main_chara_historyteacher_05

label: school_main_chara_healthteacher_01
